rule: select sorts unique entity IDs, uses a SHA256 difficulty draw then digest bytes 8:16 for the within-band index. For all easy candidates, positive easy weight makes this precisely uniform within the fresh easy pool. seen_before_task and current prefix exclusions are applied before selection.

scenarios.difficulty_weights: any finite valid distribution with positive easy weight, other bands absent

zero_easy_weight: No rated easy record is selected; no unrated generated records exist.
unconfigured_policy: None distribution returns minimum candidate entity ID. With surrogate order this would select the first remaining record; future database IDs are not known. This changes frequency, not any record key or eligible bank role.
limits: No live learner history or future database entity IDs. Freshness scenarios are explicit conditional inputs, not empirical learner frequencies.
Captured source originals may be unseen too; the generated-only pool is the applicable scenario after the originals have been seen. No live policy or database publication was inspected.
No stage is claimed to balance target coverage for every individual learner; the inspected rules do not filter by answer rank or labels.
